source.author: verg
source.text: Sed fugit interea, fugit irreparabile tempus, singula dum capti circumvectamur amore.
source.text_original: Sed fugit interea, fugit irreparabile tempus, / singula dum capti circumvectamur amore.
source.text_english: But meanwhile it flees, irretrievable time flees, while, enthralled by love, we wander round each detail.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quod et illustris poeta testatur dicens: sed fugit interea, fugit irreparabile tempus et iterum: Rhaebe, diu, res si qua diu mortalibus ulla est, uiximus.
reuse.text_original: quod et illustris poeta testatur dicens: sed fugit interea, fugit irreparabile tempus et iterum: Rhaebe, diu, res si qua diu mortalibus ulla est, uiximus.
reuse.text_english: This too the famous poet attests, saying: But meanwhile it flees, flees irretrievable time; and again: Rhaebe, for a long time, if anything is long-lasting among mortals at all, we have lived.
